svg.aria-label: Exact integer and modular matrix inversion SAT encodings from vzhn/sat-inv-matrix-py

g.text: Exact overflow-free integer inversion A · B = I over ℤ and modular ring inversion A · B ≡ I (mod m) over ℤ/mℤ
1. Exact Integer Inversion over ℤ (invmatrix.py — 4×4, det = 1)
Highlighted entry 22 requires w ≥ 6 signed bits (w = 5 ⇒ UNSAT, w = 7 auto ⇒ SAT)
Exact Dadda/Wallace Bit-Column Adder Compression (per entry i, j):
All adder sum gates are Tseitin 2-/3-XOR blocks (collapsed natively in xcnf-converted/)
SAT: det(A) = ±1 & B fits in w bits
UNSAT: det ≠ ±1, det = 0, or w small
2. Modular Ring Inversion over ℤ/mℤ (modinv.py — 3×3 mod 26)
gcd(441, 26) = 1 ⇒ unique inverse; CRT splits mod 26 into independent mod 2 × mod 13
Two Exact Encodings & Algebraic Scaling Regimes:
m=2 hides XORs behind EO(2) pairs
m=2 exposes native GF(2) XOR chains
